items.title: 14.1.2 Blood Supply of the Kidney (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the blood supply of the kidney (PDF 15).

blocks.text: Gurde ke andar khoon ka raasta renal artery se shuru hota hai, jo hilum par gurde mein dakhil hoti hai. Yeh shakhon mein bat jati hai jin se afferent arterioles banti hain. Har afferent arteriole capillaries ke ek bistar (capillary bed) yaani glomerulus mein jati hai. Jism ke zyada tar capillary beds venules (chhoti veins) mein khulte hain, lekin glomerulus ki capillaries ek efferent arteriole (bahar le jane wali chhoti artery) mein khulti hain.

blocks.title: Gurdon ko kitna khoon milta hai
blocks.text: Gurdon ko bohat zyada khoon milta hai: dil har minute jitna khoon pump karta hai (cardiac output) us ka taqreeban 20 se 25% gurdon ko jata hai.

Efferent arteriole shakhon mein bat kar peritubular capillaries banati hai. Yeh capillaries renal cortex mein proximal aur distal convoluted tubules ke gird ghana jaal banati hain. Juxtamedullary nephrons mein efferent arterioles se vasa recta bhi banti hain. Yeh medulla mein lambi aur seedhi capillaries ka jaal hain jo loops of Henle ke saath saath (parallel) chalti hain.

Cheezon ke len den (exchange) ke baad capillaries mil kar venules banati hain. Yeh venules mil kar bari veins aur aakhir mein renal vein banati hain. Renal vein hilum se gurde se bahar nikal kar inferior vena cava mein khulti hai, jo chhana hua "saaf" khoon wapas dil tak le jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Glomerulus se khoon le jane wali nali mein kya ghair mamooli hai, aur is ki ahmiyat kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Glomerulus venule ke bajaye arteriole (efferent arteriole) mein khali hota hai. Efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai, is liye glomerulus mein dabao zyada rehta hai, jo filtration chalata hai (topic 14.1.3).

items: Khoon ka raasta: renal artery, afferent arteriole, glomerulus, efferent arteriole, peritubular capillaries (aur juxtamedullary nephrons mein vasa recta), venules, renal vein, inferior vena cava.
Glomerulus venule ke bajaye efferent arteriole mein khulta hai.
Gurdon ko cardiac output ka taqreeban 20 se 25% milta hai.
